visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair wearing a black tank top stands in front of a blue swimming pool, smiling and holding up two peace signs. The lighting is bright and natural under a slightly cloudy sky with palm trees in the background. (2) A group of four young adults, two men and two women, huddle together for a group selfie. They make various cute and funny faces, with one man pouting and a woman forming a heart with her hands. (3) A young man with light brown hair and a white tank top looks directly into the camera with an exaggerated wide-eyed expression, his hands placed on his cheeks to accentuate a 'cute' pose. (4) A young woman with a ponytail, wearing a white lace cardigan over a bikini and denim shorts, waves both hands at the camera. Behind her, the blue and white curves of a large water slide stretch towards the sky. (5) A large group of about seven people lean into the camera's low-angle perspective, forming a circular framing. They all make clawing gestures with their hands and playful faces. (6) The woman from phase 4 is seen again, this time kneeling gracefully on a large pink seashell prop in front of a blue wall featuring the 'Leofoo Water Park' logo. (7) A series of rapid cuts shows a man in a black tank top performing rhythmic, jerky dance movements involving his shoulders and hands next to the pool. (8) A shirtless young man with a defined physique, wearing orange swimming trunks and a matching cap, adjusts his sunglasses while standing on a metal pool ladder. (9) A young woman with long, damp hair, wearing a white bikini top under a sheer lace cover-up, makes double peace signs and winks at the camera. (10) A young man in a white tank top makes sharp, rhythmic finger-pointing gestures toward the viewer against the vibrant pool background. (11) A man with blonde-highlighted hair wearing a white t-shirt appears surprised, with his mouth open and his hands held up in a 'paw' position. (12) A young man in a black tank top sits waist-deep in the swimming pool, splashing his hands rhythmically in time with the music's beat.
